entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|-هُوَ وَحِدٌ : مُنْفَرِدٌ بِنَفْسِهِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: boshqalardan ajralib, yakka o‘zi qolgan
meanings.uzbekExample: U uyda yakka o‘zi qoldi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|-وَجَدَهُ قَنِطاً : يَائِساً.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: umidini uzgan, butunlay noumid
meanings.uzbekExample: U yordam kelishidan umidini uzgan edi.

issues: يَائِساً umidini uzishni bildiradi; umumiy tushkun kayfiyat alohida ma’no emas

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|-وَجَدْتُهُ شَنِجاً : مُتَقَبِّضاً مُرْتَبِكاً بِفِعْلِ حَالَةِ التَّقَبُّضِ وَالتَّقَلُّصِ.

meanings.arabicGloss: مُتَقَبِّضاً مُرْتَبِكاً بِفِعْلِ حَالَةِ التَّقَبُّضِ وَالتَّقَلُّصِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: tana mushaklarining tortishib-qisqarishi sabab taranglashib, harakati noqulaylashgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Mushaklari tortishib, tanasi taranglashib qoldi.

issues: التَّقَبُّض والتَّقَلُّص tana tortishishi va qisqarishini bildiradi; oddiy chalkashlik sifatida berilmadi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|-وَجَدْتُهُ قَلِقاً : مُضْطَرِباً، مُنْزَعِجاً.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: ichki xavotir va bezovtalikni his qilayotgan
meanings.uzbekExample: U natijani kutib, xavotirli va bezovta edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|-وَجْهٌ كَرِهٌ :قَبِيحٌ،كَرِيهٌ، مَا لاَ تَحْتَمِلُهُ النَّفْسُ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yuz haqida: ko‘rimsiz, yoqimsiz va qarash og‘ir
meanings.uzbekExample: Manbada bu sifat yoqimsiz yuz ifodasiga nisbatan qo‘llangan.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|-وَجْهٌ نَضِرٌ : وَجْهٌ جَمِيلٌ، مُشْرِقٌ، نَاعِمٌ، نَاضِرٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yuz haqida: chiroyli, nurli, mayin va sog‘lom ko‘rinadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning yuzi tiniq va nurli ko‘rinardi.

issues: Chiroy, nur, mayinlik va sog‘lom-tiniq ko‘rinish bitta yuz tavsifi sifatida saqlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|-وَجْهٌ نَمِشٌ : فِيهِ بُقَعٌ تُخَالِفُ لَوْنَهُ.
entries.uzbek: sepkil yoki rangli dog‘lari bor yuz

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yuz haqida: teri rangidan farq qiladigan mayda dog‘ yoki sepkillari bor
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning yuzida mayda sepkillar bor edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|-وَسِنٌ فِي زَاوِيَةِ الغُرْفَةِ :نَاعِسٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: uyqusi kelib, mudroq holatda bo‘lgan
meanings.uzbekExample: U xonaning burchagida uyqusi kelib mudrab o‘tirardi.

issues: نَاعِسٌ uyqusi kelib mudrashni bildiradi; lanjlik va charchoq alohida ma’no emas

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|-وَلَدٌ ذَهِنٌ : ذَكِيٌّ، فَطِنٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: aqlli, tez fahmlaydigan va ziyrak
meanings.uzbekExample: Ziyrak bola masalani tez yechdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|-وَلَدٌ زَمِجٌ : غَضْبانُ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: ayni paytda jahli chiqib, g‘azablangan
meanings.uzbekExample: Bola gapdan jahli chiqib qoldi.

issues: غَضْبانُ ayni paytdagi g‘azab holati; doimiy «jahldor» fe’l-atvori qo‘shilmadi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|-وَلَدٌ سَرِعٌ : سَرِيعٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: harakati tez, chaqqon
meanings.uzbekExample: Chaqqon bola topshiriqni tez bajardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|-وَلَدٌ سَمِجٌ : قَبِيحٌ، خَبِيثٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: tashqi ko‘rinishi ko‘rimsiz yoki xulqi yomon
meanings.uzbekExample: Manbada bu sifat ko‘rinish yoki xulqdagi yoqimsizlikni bildiradi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|-وَلَدٌ شَبِقٌ : شَدِيدُ الشَّهْوَةِ الجِنْسِيَّةِ.
entries.uzbek: jinsiy mayli juda kuchli yosh kishi

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yosh kishi haqida: jinsiy mayli juda kuchli
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu sifat jinsiy mayli kuchli yosh kishini ifodalash uchun qo‘llangan.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|-وَلَدٌ غَنِجٌ : ذُو غُنْجٍ، أَيْ ذُو دَلاَلٍ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: erka, noz va erkalik bilan muomala qiladigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Erka bola noz bilan gapirdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|-وَلَدٌ قَذِعٌ : ذُو قَذَعٍ، أَيْ فَاحِشٌ فِي كَلاَمِهِ.

meanings.arabicGloss: ذُو قَذَعٍ، أَيْ فَاحِشٌ فِي كَلاَمِهِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: gapida uyatsiz, haqoratli va qo‘pol so‘zlarni ko‘p ishlatadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U haqoratli va qo‘pol so‘zlar bilan gapirdi.

issues: فَاحِشٌ فِي كَلاَمِهِ — gapida uyatsiz va haqoratli so‘z ishlatadi; mavjud «fohishalik qiluvchi» tarjimasi xato edi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|-وَلَدٌ كَسِلٌ :مُتَهَاوِنٌ فِي عَمَلِهِ وَأَدَاءِ وَاجِبِهِ، مُتَقَاعِسٌ، مُتَرَاخٍ.
entries.uzbek: ish va vazifasiga sust qaraydigan dangasa

meanings.arabicGloss: مُتَهَاوِنٌ فِي عَمَلِهِ وَأَدَاءِ وَاجِبِهِ، مُتَقَاعِسٌ، مُتَرَاخٍ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: ishi va vazifasini bajarishda sustkashlik qilib, mas’uliyatsiz va dangasa bo‘ladigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Dangasa bola vazifasini vaqtida bajarmadi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|-وَلَدٌ وَعِقٌ : لَئِيمُ الْخُلُقِ، شَرِسٌ، نَزِقٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: xulqi yomon, tajang, dag‘al va tez o‘zini yo‘qotadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Tajang bola arzimas gapdan janjal chiqardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|-وَلَدٌ وَقِحٌ : قَلِيلُ الْحَيَاءِ، ذُو وَقَاحَةٍ، الْمُجْتَرِئُ عَلَى القَبَائِحِ.
entries.uzbek: uyatsiz va qabih ishlardan tap tortmaydigan

meanings.arabicGloss: قَلِيلُ الْحَيَاءِ، ذُو وَقَاحَةٍ، الْمُجْتَرِئُ عَلَى القَبَائِحِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: hayo-andishasi kam, uyatsiz va qabih ishlarni qilishdan tap tortmaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U uyatsiz xatti-harakatidan hech tortinmadi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|-يَوْمٌ خَصِرٌ : بَارِدٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kun haqida: havo harorati past, sovuq
meanings.uzbekExample: Sovuq kunda issiq kiyim kiyildi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|-يَوْمٌ وَحِمٌ : شَدِيدُ الْحَرِّ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kun haqida: harorati nihoyatda yuqori, jazirama issiq
meanings.uzbekExample: Jazirama issiq kunda odamlar soyaga o‘tishdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|-يَوْمُ دَفِئٌ : مُعْتَدِلٌ، دَافِئٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kun haqida: sovuq ham, issiq ham bo‘lmagan, iliq va mo‘tadil
meanings.uzbekExample: Iliq va mo‘tadil kunda sayr qilish yoqimli edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).| :رَجُلٌ سَمِقٌ :طَوِيلٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: bo‘yi uzun, baland bo‘yli
meanings.uzbekExample: U baland bo‘yli kishi edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).| ذُو غَضَرٍ، ذُو غَضَارَةٍ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: boylik, ne’mat va farovonlikka ega
meanings.uzbekExample: Ular farovon va to‘kin hayot kechirishardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- اِرْتَدَى قَمِيصاً قَشِباً : جَدِيداً، نَظِيفاً.|2- سَيْفٌ قَشِبٌ : حَدِيثُ عَهْدٍ بِالْجِلاَءِ.
entries.uzbek: yangi va toza kiyim; yaqinda sayqallangan qilich

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kiyim haqida: yangi va toza
meanings.uzbekExample: U yangi va toza ko‘ylak kiydi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: qilich haqida: yaqinda sayqal berilgan, yangi yaltiratilgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Yaqinda sayqallangan qilich yaltirab turardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- جَاءَ فَرِداً : وَاحِداً.|2- عَمَلٌ فَرِدٌ : مُتَفَرِّدٌ.|3- سَيْفٌ فَرِدٌ : لاَ نَظِيرَ لَهُ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bir o‘zi, yakka holda
meanings.uzbekExample: U yig‘ilishga yakka o‘zi keldi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: ish yoki asar haqida: boshqalardan ajralib turadigan, o‘ziga xos
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu uslub o‘ziga xosligi bilan ajralib turadi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: qilich haqida: o‘xshashi va tengi yo‘q
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu qilichning tengi yo‘q deb ta’riflandi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- حَاوَلَ أَنْ يُنْقِذَ الغَرِقَ مِنَ الغَرَقِ : مَنْ غَلَبَهُ الْمَاءُ بِالاخْتِنَاقِ أَوْ كَادَ.|2- غَرِقٌ فِي هُمُومِهِ وَأَحْزَانِهِ : غَائِصٌ فِيهَا.

meanings.arabicExample: حَاوَلَ أَنْ يُنْقِذَ الغَرِقَ مِنَ الغَرَقِ
meanings.arabicGloss: مَنْ غَلَبَهُ الْمَاءُ بِالاخْتِنَاقِ أَوْ كَادَ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: suv bosib, nafas ololmay cho‘kayotgan yoki cho‘kish arafasidagi kishi
meanings.uzbekExample: Qutqaruvchi cho‘kayotgan odamni suvdan olib chiqdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: majozan: g‘am va tashvishlariga butunlay botib ketgan
meanings.uzbekExample: U g‘am va tashvishlariga botib qoldi.

issues: Birinchi ma’no faqat cho‘kib bo‘lgan emas, suv bosib nafas ololmayotgan yoki cho‘kish arafasidagi kishini ham qamrab oladi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- حَقْلٌ خَصِبٌ : كَثِيرُ الْعُشْبِ وَالنَّمَاءِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: dala haqida: o‘t-o‘lani va o‘sishi mo‘l, unumdor va serhosil
meanings.uzbekExample: Unumdor dalada o‘t-o‘lan qalin o‘sdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- رَجُلٌ ضَغِنٌ : حَاقِدٌ، ذُوحِقْدٍ.|2- عُودٌ ضَغِنٌ : أَعْوَجُ.|3- فَرَسٌ ضَغِنٌ : صَعْبُ الاِنْقِيَادِ وَالْمِرَاسِ.
entries.uzbek: kek saqlaydigan; egri tayoq; boshqarish qiyin ot

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: ko‘nglida kek va gina saqlaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U eski adovatni unutmay, ko‘nglida kek saqlardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: tayoq yoki yog‘och haqida: egri, qiyshiq
meanings.uzbekExample: Egri tayoq devorga suyab qo‘yildi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: ot haqida: jilovga bo‘ysunmaydigan, o‘rgatish va boshqarish qiyin
meanings.uzbekExample: Boshqarish qiyin ot chavandozga bo‘ysunmadi.

issues: حَاقِدٌ vaqtinchalik g‘azab emas, ko‘ngilda kek va gina saqlashdir

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- رَجُلٌ طَحِلٌ : كَبِيرُ الطِّحَالِ.|2- جَاءَ طَحِلاً : غَضْبَانَ.|3- إِنَاءٌ طَحِلٌ : مَلآنُ.|4- مَاءٌ طَحِلٌ : عَلاَهُ الطُّحْلُبُ.
entries.uzbek: talog‘i kattalashgan; g‘azablangan; to‘la idish; suv o‘ti qoplagan suv

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: talog‘i kattalashgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Tekshiruvda bemorning talog‘i kattalashgani aniqlandi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: g‘azablangan, jahli chiqqan
meanings.uzbekExample: U jahli chiqib keldi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: idish haqida: ichi to‘la
meanings.uzbekExample: Idish suv bilan to‘la edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: suv haqida: yuzini suv o‘ti yoki suvo‘t qoplagan
meanings.uzbekExample: Hovuz suvining yuzini suvo‘t qopladi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- رَجُلٌ عَبِرٌ : ذُو عَبْرَةٍ. وَحُزْنٍ.|2- سَهْمٌ عَبِرٌ : كَثِيرُ الرِّيشِ.
entries.uzbek: ko‘z yoshli va g‘amgin; pati ko‘p o‘q

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: ko‘ziga yosh olgan va g‘amgin
meanings.uzbekExample: U ko‘ziga yosh olib, g‘amgin holda turardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: o‘q haqida: orqa qismiga ko‘p pat o‘rnatilgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Ko‘p patli o‘q kamonga joylandi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- رَجُلٌ فَرِقٌ : شَدِيدُ الفَزَعِ وَالْخَوْفِ.|2- نَبْتٌ فَرِقٌ : صَغِيرٌ لَمْ يُغَطِّ الأَرْضَ.
entries.uzbek: juda qo‘rqoq; yerni hali qoplamagan nihol

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: juda tez va qattiq qo‘rqadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U har bir shovqindan qattiq qo‘rqardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: o‘simlik haqida: kichik bo‘lib, hali yer yuzini qoplamagan
meanings.uzbekExample: Yangi ungan nihollar hali yer yuzini qoplamagan edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- رَجُلٌ قَرِعٌ : لاَ يَنَامُ.|2- ظُفْرٌ قَرِعٌ : فَاسِدٌ.|3- أَرْضٌ قَرِعَةٌ : لاَ تُنْبِتُ شَيْئاً.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: uxlamaydigan, uyqusi kelmaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U tun bo‘yi uxlamay chiqdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: tirnoq haqida: kasallangan yoki shikastlanib buzilgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Shikastlangan tirnoq shifokorga ko‘rsatildi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yer haqida: hech qanday o‘simlik o‘smaydigan, hosilsiz
meanings.uzbekExample: Hosilsiz yerda o‘simlik unmasdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- رَجُلٌ نَقِرٌ : غَضْبَانُ.|2- حَيَوَانٌ نَقِرٌ : مُصَابٌ بِدَاءِ النُّقَرَةِ.|3- مَالَهُ بِمَوْضِعِ كَذَا نَقِرٌ : أَيْ بِئْرٌ أَوْ مَاءٌ.
entries.uzbek: g‘azablangan; oyog‘i kasallangan chorva; quduq yoki suvning yo‘qligini bildiruvchi qadimiy ibora

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: g‘azablangan, jahli chiqqan
meanings.uzbekExample: U jahli chiqib gapirdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: qo‘y yoki qoramol haqida: oyog‘ini shishirib, oqsoqlatadigan nuqara kasalligiga chalingan
meanings.uzbekExample: Oyog‘i shishib oqsoqlagan chorva veterinarga ko‘rsatildi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: «falon joyda uning na qudug‘i, na suvi bor» mazmunidagi qadimiy inkor iborasida: quduq yoki suv
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu qadimiy ibora kishining o‘sha joyda qudug‘i ham, suvi ham yo‘qligini bildiradi.

issues: داء النُّقَرَة podagra emas; qo‘y va qoramol oyoqlarini shishirib, oqsoqlatadigan chorva kasalligi
ما له بموضع كذا نقر tasdiq emas, o‘sha joyda quduq yoki suv yo‘qligini bildiruvchi inkor iborasi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- رَجُلٌ وَغِلٌ : مُدَّعٍ نَسَباً كَاذِباً.|2- حَيَوَانٌ وَغِلٌ : سَيِّءُ الغِذَاءِ.
entries.uzbek: yolg‘on nasab da’vo qiladigan; yomon oziqlangan hayvon

meanings.uzbekMeaning: o‘zini aslida mansub bo‘lmagan nasabga bog‘lab, yolg‘on da’vo qiladigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U o‘ziga tegishli bo‘lmagan nasabni yolg‘on da’vo qildi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: hayvon haqida: yetarli yoki sifatli oziq berilmagan, yomon oziqlangan
meanings.uzbekExample: Yomon oziqlangan hayvon ozib ketdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- رَجُلُ يَقِنٌ : الَّذِي لاَ يَسْمَعُ شَيْئاً إِلاَّ أَيْقَنَ بِهِ.|2- يَقِنٌ بِالْمُوسِيقَى :مُولَعٌ بِهَا.
entries.uzbek: eshitganiga darhol ishonadigan; musiqaga qattiq berilgan

meanings.arabicGloss: الَّذِي لاَ يَسْمَعُ شَيْئاً إِلاَّ أَيْقَنَ بِهِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: eshitgan har bir gapini tekshirmay rost deb ishonadigan, o‘ta ishonuvchan
meanings.uzbekExample: U eshitgan har bir xabarga tekshirmay ishonardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: musiqaga qattiq qiziqib, unga berilgan
meanings.uzbekExample: U musiqaga qattiq berilgan edi.

issues: Birinchi ma’no oddiy ishonch emas, eshitganini tekshirmay rost deb bilish; ikkinchisi oddiy qiziqishdan kuchliroq berilish

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- زَمِرُ الشَّعْرِ أَو الصُّوفِ أَو الرِّيشِ : قَليلُهُ.|2- وَلَدٌ زَمِرٌ : قَليلُ الْمُروءةِ.|3- طِفْلٌ زَمِرٌ : حَسنُ الوَجْهِ.|4- زَمِرُ الغِناءِ : حَسَنُهُ.|5- عَطاءٌ زَمِرٌ : قَليلٌ.
entries.uzbek: siyrak; muruvvati kam; chiroyli yuzli; yoqimli qo‘shiq; oz hadya

meanings.arabicExample: زَمِرُ الشَّعْرِ أَو الصُّوفِ أَو الرِّيشِ
meanings.uzbekMeaning: soch, jun yoki pat haqida: oz, siyrak
meanings.uzbekExample: Hayvonning juni siyrak edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: muruvvati va olijanobligi kam
meanings.uzbekExample: Manbada bu sifat muruvvati kam bolaga nisbatan qo‘llangan.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: yuzi chiroyli
meanings.uzbekExample: Chiroyli yuzli bola kulib turardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: qo‘shiq yoki kuylash haqida: chiroyli va yoqimli
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning kuylashi yoqimli edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: hadya yoki beriladigan narsa haqida: oz, kam
meanings.uzbekExample: Berilgan hadya miqdori oz edi.

issues: قَليلُ الْمُروءةِ «kamtar» emas, muruvvati va olijanobligi kam degan salbiy tavsif

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- سَحَابٌ هَمِعٌ : مَاطِرٌ.|2- عَيْنٌ هَمِعَةٌ : لاَ تَزَالُ تَدْمَعُ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bulut haqida: yomg‘ir yog‘diradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Yomg‘irli bulut shahar ustini qopladi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: ko‘z haqida: tinmay yoshlanib turadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning ko‘zi tinmay yoshlanardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- شَجَرٌ وَرِقٌ : كَثِيرُ الوَرَقِ.|2- شَجَرَةٌ وَرِقَةٌ : خَضْرَاءُ الوَرَقِ، مُورِقَةٌ زَاهِيَةٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: daraxt haqida: barglari ko‘p, qalin bargli
meanings.uzbekExample: Qalin bargli daraxt yaxshi soya berdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: daraxt haqida: barglari yashil, ko‘rkam va yam-yashil
meanings.uzbekExample: Yam-yashil daraxt bog‘ni bezab turardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- شَعْرٌ عَكِشٌ : مُتَجَعِّدٌ، مُتَلَبِّدٌ.|2- شَجَرَةٌ عَكِشَةٌ : فُرُوعُهَا كَثِيرَةٌ وَمُلْتَفَّةٌ.
entries.uzbek: jingalak va chigallashgan soch; shoxlari ko‘p va chirmashgan daraxt

meanings.uzbekMeaning: soch haqida: jingalak, bir-biriga kirishib chigallashgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning sochi jingalak va chigallashgan edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: daraxt haqida: shoxlari ko‘p va bir-biriga chirmashib ketgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Daraxtning ko‘p shoxlari bir-biriga chirmashgan edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- شَعْرٌ لَبِدٌ : شَعْرٌ مُتَلَبِّدٌ.|2- رَجُلٌ لَبِدٌ : قَاعِدٌ فِي مَنْزِلِهِ لاَ يَتْرُكُهُ.
entries.uzbek: yopishib chigallashgan soch; uyidan chiqmaydigan kishi

meanings.uzbekMeaning: soch haqida: tutamlari bir-biriga yopishib, chigallashgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Taralmagan soch bir-biriga yopishib chigallashgan edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: uyida o‘tirib, deyarli tashqariga chiqmaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U ko‘p vaqt uyida o‘tirar, tashqariga kam chiqardi.

issues: مُتَلَبِّدٌ sochning to‘kilishi yoki yoyilishi emas, tutamlarning bir-biriga yopishib chigallashishidir

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- طَرِيقٌ لَزِبٌ : ضَيِّقٌ- عَيْشٌ لَزِبٌ.|2- مَالُهُ لَزِبٌ : قَلِيلٌ.
entries.uzbek: tor yo‘l yoki tang turmush; moli oz

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yo‘l haqida: tor; turmush haqida: tang va qiyin
meanings.uzbekExample: Ular tor yo‘ldan o‘tib, tang sharoitda yashashardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: mol-dunyosi haqida: oz, kam
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning mol-dunyosi oz edi.

issues: Birinchi ma’nodagi عَيْشٌ لَزِبٌ tang turmush konteksti tarjimada tiklandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- طَعْمٌ مَضِرٌ : حَامِضٌ.|2- عَيْشٌ مَضِرٌ : نَاعِمٌ.|3- ذَهَبَ دَمُهُ خَضِراً مَضِراً :هَدَراً.
entries.uzbek: nordon ta’m; farovon turmush; behuda to‘kilgan qon

meanings.uzbekMeaning: ta’m haqida: nordon
meanings.uzbekExample: Mevaning ta’mi nordon edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: turmush haqida: rohatli, farovon va yumshoq
meanings.uzbekExample: Ular rohatli va farovon hayot kechirishdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: qon haqida: behuda to‘kilgan, xuni talab qilinmay qolgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning qoni behuda to‘kilib, xuni talab qilinmay qoldi.

issues: هَدَراً qonning oddiy foydasizligi emas, behuda to‘kilishi va xuni talab qilinmay qolishini bildiradi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- عَظْمٌ نَخِرٌ : مُتَفَتِّتٌ، مُجَوَّفٌ- عُودٌ نَخِرٌ :-خَشَبٌ نَخِرٌ :-سِنٌّ نَخِرَةٌ.النازعات آية 11 إِذَا كُنَّا عِظَاماً نَخِرَةً (قرآن) : أَيْ بَالِيَةً.

meanings.arabicGloss: مُتَفَتِّتٌ، مُجَوَّفٌ- عُودٌ نَخِرٌ :-خَشَبٌ نَخِرٌ :-سِنٌّ نَخِرَةٌ.النازعات آية 11 إِذَا كُنَّا عِظَاماً نَخِرَةً (قرآن) : أَيْ بَالِيَةً.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: suyak, yog‘och yoki tish haqida: eskirib-chirib, ichi kovaklashgan va uvalanadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: «Chirib ketgan suyak bo‘lganimizdan keyinmi?» (Qur’on, Noziot surasi, 79:11)

issues: Suyak, yog‘och va tish misollari bitta chirib-kovaklashish ma’nosida saqlandi
Noziot surasi 79:11 misoli o‘zbekcha mazmunda berildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- عَيْشٌ كَدِرٌ :عَيْشٌ مُضْنٍ، شَاقٌّ، صَعْبٌ.|2- لَوْنٌ كَدِرٌ : شَاحِبٌ، بَاهِتٌ- خَرَجَ إِلَى الشَّارِعِ وَفِي نَفْسِهِ شُعُورٌ كَدِرٌ هُوَ مَزِيجٌ مِنْ أَسًى وَأَسَفٍ. (حنا مينه).
entries.uzbek: mashaqqatli turmush; xira rang yoki g‘ash kayfiyat

meanings.uzbekMeaning: turmush haqida: holdan toydiradigan, og‘ir va mashaqqatli
meanings.uzbekExample: U og‘ir va mashaqqatli hayot kechirdi.

meanings.arabicGloss: شَاحِبٌ، بَاهِتٌ- خَرَجَ إِلَى الشَّارِعِ وَفِي نَفْسِهِ شُعُورٌ كَدِرٌ هُوَ مَزِيجٌ مِنْ أَسًى وَأَسَفٍ. (حنا مينه).
meanings.uzbekMeaning: rang haqida: xira va rangsiz; hissiyot haqida majozan: g‘am va afsus aralash g‘ash
meanings.uzbekExample: U ko‘chaga g‘am va afsus aralash g‘ash kayfiyatda chiqdi.

issues: G‘ash hissiyot misoli manbadagi ikkinchi xira-loyqa ma’noning majoziy qo‘llanishi; uchinchi alohida ma’no qilinmadi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- فَلاَّحٌ رَتِعٌ : مُخْصِبٌ لا يَنْقُصُهُ شَيْءٌ.|2- كَلأٌ رَتِعٌ : يَكْفِي الرَّعِيَّةَ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: dehqon haqida: hosili mo‘l, to‘kin va hech narsaga muhtoj bo‘lmagan
meanings.uzbekExample: Hosili mo‘l dehqon to‘kin yashardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: o‘t-o‘lan haqida: chorva uchun yetarli darajada mo‘l
meanings.uzbekExample: Yaylovdagi o‘t-o‘lan butun poda uchun yetarli edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- قَائِدٌ شَجِعٌ : شُجَاعٌ.|2- جَمَلٌ شَجِعُ القَوَائِمِ : سَرِيعُ نَقْلِهَا.|3- بَقَرٌ شَجِعٌ : مَجْنُونٌ.
entries.uzbek: jasur sarkarda; oyoqlari tez tuya; telbalangan qoramol

meanings.uzbekMeaning: sarkarda haqida: jasur va botir
meanings.uzbekExample: Jasur sarkarda qo‘shinga boshchilik qildi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: tuya haqida: oyoqlarini tez tashlab, tez yuradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Tuya oyoqlarini tez tashlab yo‘l bosdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: qoramol haqida: telbalangan, o‘zini boshqara olmaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Telbalangan qoramol podadan ajratildi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- كَلاَمٌ غَلِقٌ : مُبْهَمٌ، مُلْتَبِسٌ.|2- وَلَدٌ غَلِقٌ : ضَيِّقُ الخُلُقِ.|3- إِنْسَانٌ غَلِقٌ : كَثِيرُ الْغَضَبِ.
entries.uzbek: mavhum gap; fe’li tor bola; ko‘p jahli chiqadigan kishi

meanings.uzbekMeaning: gap yoki matn haqida: mavhum, chalkash va tushunish qiyin
meanings.uzbekExample: Mavhum gapning ma’nosini anglash qiyin bo‘ldi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: fe’li tor, muomalasi qiyin
meanings.uzbekExample: Fe’li tor bola boshqalar bilan tez tortishardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: ko‘p va tez jahli chiqadigan, jizzaki
meanings.uzbekExample: Jizzaki kishi arzimas gapdan ham jahli chiqardi.

issues: كَثِيرُ الْغَضَبِ tez-tez jahli chiqadigan fe’l-atvor; mavjud «juda g‘azablangan» vaqtinchalik holat tarjimasi tuzatildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- لِسَانُهُ طَلِقٌ : فَصِيحُ اللِّسَانِ.|2- طَلِقُ الوَجْهِ : ضَاحِكُهُ.
entries.uzbek: tili ravon; ochiq va kulimsiragan yuz

meanings.uzbekMeaning: tili ravon, fasohat bilan so‘zlaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U ravon va fasohatli nutq so‘zladi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yuz haqida: ochiq, kulimsiragan va xushchaqchaq
meanings.uzbekExample: U mehmonlarni kulimsiragan yuz bilan kutib oldi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- مَاءٌ شَبِمٌ : بَارِدٌ.|2- وَلَدٌ شَبِمٌ : جَائِعٌ وَبِهِ بَرْدٌ.|3- قَلْبٌ شَبِمٌ : بَارِدٌ، أيْ قَلِيلُ الحِسِّ.
entries.uzbek: sovuq suv; och va sovqotgan bola; hissiz qalb

meanings.uzbekMeaning: suv haqida: sovuq
meanings.uzbekExample: Sovuq suv chanqoqni bosdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: och qolgan va sovqotgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Och va sovqotgan bolaga ovqat hamda issiq kiyim berildi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: qalb haqida majozan: sovuq, hissiyoti sust va befarq
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning sovuq va befarq munosabati boshqalarni ranjitdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- مَاءٌ عَكِرٌ : مَاءٌ اِخْتَلَطَتْ أَوْ جَرَتْ فِيهِ الأَتْرِبَةُ وَالقَاذُورَاتُ- وَفَجْأَةً اِرْتَطَمَتْ مِيَاهُ النَّهْرِ وَارْتَدَّتْ إِلَى الوَرَاءِ عَكِرَةً مُصْطَخِبَةً جَائِشَةً.|2- يَصْطَادُ فِي الْمَاءِ العَكِرِ : أَيْ يُحَاوِلُ اسْتِغْلالَ الفُرْصَةِ لِيَسْتَفِيدَ ويُفْسِدَ الوُدَّ.
entries.uzbek: loyqa va iflos suv; loyqa suvda baliq tutmoq

meanings.arabicGloss: مَاءٌ اِخْتَلَطَتْ أَوْ جَرَتْ فِيهِ الأَتْرِبَةُ وَالقَاذُورَاتُ- وَفَجْأَةً اِرْتَطَمَتْ مِيَاهُ النَّهْرِ وَارْتَدَّتْ إِلَى الوَرَاءِ عَكِرَةً مُصْطَخِبَةً جَائِشَةً.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: suv haqida: tuproq, chiqindi yoki boshqa aralashma qo‘shilib loyqalangan va ifloslangan
meanings.uzbekExample: Daryo suvi loyqalanib, kuchli to‘lqinlandi.

meanings.arabicGloss: أَيْ يُحَاوِلُ اسْتِغْلالَ الفُرْصَةِ لِيَسْتَفِيدَ ويُفْسِدَ الوُدَّ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: «loyqa suvda baliq tutmoq» iborasida: chalkash vaziyatdan shaxsiy foyda uchun foydalanib, munosabatni buzmoq
meanings.uzbekExample: U nizoli vaziyatdan o‘z foydasi uchun foydalanishga urindi.

issues: Ikkinchi ma’no «loyqa suvda baliq tutmoq» iborasining shaxsiy foyda va munosabatni buzish jihatlarini saqlaydi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- مَاءٌ غَدِقٌ : غَزِيرٌ، كَثِيرٌ- مَطَرٌ غَدِقٌ.|2- عُشْبٌ غَدِقٌ : مُبْتَلٌّ، رَيَّانُ.
entries.uzbek: mo‘l suv yoki yomg‘ir; nam va suvga to‘yingan o‘t

meanings.uzbekMeaning: suv yoki yomg‘ir haqida: juda mo‘l va ko‘p
meanings.uzbekExample: Mo‘l yomg‘ir dalalarni sug‘ordi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: o‘t-o‘lan haqida: nam, ho‘l va suvga to‘yingan
meanings.uzbekExample: Yomg‘irdan keyin o‘tlar nam va suvga to‘yingan edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- مَاءٌ قَمِرٌ : كَثِيرٌ.|2- لَيْلٌ قَمِرٌ : يُنِيرُهُ الْقَمَرُ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: suv haqida: mo‘l va ko‘p
meanings.uzbekExample: Quduqda suv mo‘l edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: tun haqida: oy nuri bilan yoritilgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Oy yoritgan tunda yo‘l ravshan ko‘rinardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- مَكَانٌ عَبِقٌ : تَفُوحُ مِنْهُ رَائِحَةُ الطِّيبِ.|2- وَلَدٌ عَبِقٌ : ظَرِيفٌ.
entries.uzbek: xushbo‘y joy; yoqimli va nazokatli bola

meanings.uzbekMeaning: joy haqida: atir yoki yoqimli hid taralib turgan, xushbo‘y
meanings.uzbekExample: Xona gullarning xushbo‘y hidiga to‘ldi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: yoqimli, nazokatli va odobli
meanings.uzbekExample: U yoqimli va odobli bola edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- مَكَانٌ عَمِدٌ :مُبَلَّلٌ بِالْمَطَرِ.|2- عَمِدُ الثرَّى : أَيْ كَثِيرُ الْمَعْرُوفِ.
entries.uzbek: yomg‘irdan ho‘l joy; yaxshiligi ko‘p inson

meanings.uzbekMeaning: joy haqida: yomg‘ir suvi bilan ho‘l bo‘lgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Yomg‘irdan ho‘l bo‘lgan yerda izlar qoldi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: yaxshilik va ehsoni ko‘p, saxovatli
meanings.uzbekExample: U yaxshiligi ko‘p va saxovatli inson edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- مَكَانٌ قَذِرٌ : وَسِخٌ.|2- رَجُلٌ قَذِرٌ : خَبِيثٌ، دَنِيءٌ، خَسِيسٌ.
entries.uzbek: iflos joy; yaramas va pastkash kishi

meanings.uzbekMeaning: joy haqida: kir va iflos
meanings.uzbekExample: Iflos joy yaxshilab tozalandi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida majozan: yaramas, razil va pastkash
meanings.uzbekExample: Pastkash xatti-harakat keskin qoralandi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- مَكَانٌ مَرِعٌ : خَصِيبٌ.|2- رَجُلٌ مَرِعٌ : يَطْلُبُ الْمَرْعَ.
entries.uzbek: o‘tloqi serob joy; yaylov izlaydigan kishi

meanings.uzbekMeaning: joy haqida: o‘t-o‘lani mo‘l, yaylovi unumdor
meanings.uzbekExample: O‘t-o‘lani mo‘l yaylov chorva uchun qulay edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: chorva uchun o‘tloq yoki yaylov izlaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Cho‘pon poda uchun yangi yaylov izlab yo‘lga chiqdi.

issues: خَصِيبٌ bu yerda umumiy serhosillikdan ko‘ra o‘tloqi-yaylovi serob joy kontekstida

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- مَكَانٌ وَخِمٌ : وَبِيءٌ- أَرْضٌ وَخِمَةٌ.|2- رَجُلٌ وَخِمٌ : ثَقِيلٌ.
entries.uzbek: kasallik tarqalgan nosog‘lom joy; muomalasi og‘ir kishi

meanings.uzbekMeaning: joy haqida: havosi yoki sharoiti nosog‘lom, kasallik tarqalgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Nosog‘lom hududda yuqumli kasallik ko‘paydi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: muomalasi og‘ir, sust yoki yoqimsiz
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning og‘ir muomalasi suhbatni qiyinlashtirdi.

issues: وَبِيءٌ oddiy «zararli» emas, kasallik tarqalgan nosog‘lom hududni bildiradi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- هُوَ خَشِنٌ بِطَبْعِهِ : مُتَشَدِّدٌ، عَنِيفٌ، فَظٌّ.|2- وَجَّهَ إِلَيْهِ كَلِمَاتٍ خَشِنَةً :قَاسِيَةً، فَظَّةً، شَدِيدَةَ اللَّهْجَةِ.|3- الْجِنْسُ الْخَشِنُ : الرِّجَالُ عَكْس الْجِنْسِ اللَّطِيفِ.
entries.uzbek: qattiqqo‘l va dag‘al; keskin so‘z; erkaklar haqidagi eskirgan ibora

meanings.uzbekMeaning: fe’l-atvori haqida: qattiqqo‘l, dag‘al, zo‘ravon va qo‘pol
meanings.uzbekExample: U tabiatan qattiqqo‘l va dag‘al edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: so‘z yoki gap haqida: qo‘pol, keskin va qattiq ohangli
meanings.uzbekExample: U suhbatdoshiga keskin va qo‘pol so‘zlar aytdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: «qo‘pol jins» degan eskirgan iborada: erkaklar; «nozik jins» iborasiga qarama-qarshi
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu tarixiy ibora erkaklarni ayollarga qarama-qarshi qo‘yib atash uchun ishlatilgan.

issues: الجِنْسُ الْخَشِنُ zamonaviy neytral atama emas; tarixiy-eskirgan ibora sifatida belgilandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- هُوَ قَطِمٌ : يَشْتَهِي اللَّحْمَ.|2- وَلَدٌ قَطِمٌ : غَضْبَانُ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: go‘sht yeyishni qattiq istaydigan, go‘sht tusaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U go‘shtli taomni qattiq tusadi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: jahli chiqqan, g‘azablangan
meanings.uzbekExample: Bolaning jahli chiqib qoldi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- وَجَدْتُهُ طَوِياً : جَائِعاً.|2- هُوَ طَوِيُ البَطْنِ : ضَامِرُ البَطْنِ، صَغِيرُهُ خِلْقَةً.
entries.uzbek: och; tug‘ma ravishda qorni kichik va ichiga tortilgan

meanings.uzbekMeaning: och qolgan, ovqatga muhtoj
meanings.uzbekExample: Men uni och holatda uchratdim.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: tana tuzilishi haqida: qorni tug‘ma ravishda kichik va ichiga tortilgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Manbada bu sifat qorni tug‘ma kichik kishiga nisbatan qo‘llangan.

issues: Mavjud «ochiq» so‘zi manbaga aloqasiz xato; birinchi ma’no ochlik, ikkinchisi tug‘ma kichik qorin tuzilishi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- وَلَدٌ حَمِقٌ : أَحْمَقُ.|2- شَابٌّ حَمِقٌ : خَفِيفُ اللِّحْيَةِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: aqlsiz ish qiladigan, ahmoq
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning ahmoqona ishi muammoga sabab bo‘ldi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yigit haqida: soqoli siyrak
meanings.uzbekExample: Yigitning soqoli siyrak edi.

issues: خَفِيفُ اللِّحْيَةِ «yengil tabiatli» emas, soqoli siyrak yigitni bildiradi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- وَلَدٌ رَجِلٌ :يَمْشِي عَلَى رِجْلَيْهِ.|2- شَعْرٌ رَجِلٌ : يَجْمَعُ مَا بَيْنَ الاسْتِرْسالِ وَالجُعودَةِ.
entries.uzbek: piyoda yuradigan; tekis va jingalak oralig‘idagi to‘lqinli soch

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: transport yoki ulovsiz, oyoqda piyoda yuradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Bola maktabga piyoda bordi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: soch haqida: mutlaqo tekis ham, qattiq jingalak ham bo‘lmay, ikkisining oralig‘idagi to‘lqinli
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning sochi mayin to‘lqinli edi.

issues: Ikkinchi ma’no tekis va jingalak soch oralig‘idagi to‘lqinli tuzilishni bildiradi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- وَلَدٌ زَعِرٌ : شَعْرُهُ قَليلٌ وَمُتَفَرِّقٌ.|2- حَقْلٌ زَعِرٌ : قَليلُ النَّباتِ.
entries.uzbek: sochi siyrak va tarqoq; o‘simligi kam dala

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: sochi oz, siyrak va tarqoq o‘sgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Bolaning sochi siyrak va tarqoq edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: dala haqida: o‘simligi juda kam, siyrak
meanings.uzbekExample: Dalada o‘simliklar siyrak o‘sgan edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- وَلَدٌ سَدِرٌ :مُتَحَيِّرٌ.|2- هُوَ السِّدْرُ : البَحْرُ.|3- جَمَلٌ سَدِرٌ : هَرِمٌ.
entries.uzbek: hayron va sarosimadagi; dengiz; qari tuya

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: nima qilishini bilmay hayron va sarosimada qolgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Bola notanish vaziyatda sarosimada qoldi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: as-Sidr — dengizning arabcha nomlaridan biri
meanings.uzbekExample: As-Sidr klassik arab tilida dengiz nomi sifatida uchraydi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: tuya haqida: qarib qolgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Qari tuya sekin yurardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- وَلَدٌ ضَرِمٌ : جَائِعٌ.|2- فَرَسٌ ضَرِمٌ : شَدِيدُ العَدْوِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: och qolgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Och bolaga ovqat berildi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: ot haqida: juda tez va shiddat bilan yuguradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Chopqir ot poygada oldinga chiqdi.

issues: جَائِعٌ och qolgan degani; ochko‘zlik fe’l-atvori qo‘shilmadi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- وَلَدٌ طَبِعٌ : سَيِّءُ الْخُلُقِ.|2- مَعْدِنٌ طَبِعٌ : صَدِئٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: xulqi yomon, badfe’l
meanings.uzbekExample: Badxulq bola boshqalar bilan tez tortishardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: metall haqida: zang bosgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Zanglagan metall buyum tozalandi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- وَلَدٌ طَرِفٌ : لاَ يَثْبُتُ عَلَى صُحْبَةِ أَحَدٍ لِمَلَلِهِ.|2- مَاشِيَةٌ طَرِفَةٌ : لاَ تَثْبُتُ عَلَى مَرْعىً وَاحِدٍ.
entries.uzbek: do‘stidan tez zerikadigan; bir yaylovda turmaydigan chorva

meanings.arabicGloss: لاَ يَثْبُتُ عَلَى صُحْبَةِ أَحَدٍ لِمَلَلِهِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: tez zerikgani sabab biror kishining do‘stligida uzoq sobit turmaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U tez zerikib, do‘stlarini tez-tez almashtirardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: chorva haqida: bir yaylovda uzoq turmay, boshqasiga o‘tib yuradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Chorva bir yaylovda turmay, boshqa o‘tloqqa o‘tdi.

issues: Do‘stlikdagi beqarorlik sababi — tez zerikish; chorva ma’nosi esa bir yaylovda turmaslik

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- وَلَدٌ عَوِرٌ : سَيِّئُ الْخُلُقِ.|2- شَيْءٌ عَوِرٌ : لاَ حَافِظَ لَهُ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: xulqi yomon, badfe’l
meanings.uzbekExample: Badfe’l bola tengdoshlari bilan chiqisha olmadi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: narsa yoki joy haqida: saqlaydigan yoki qo‘riqlaydigan kishisi yo‘q, himoyasiz
meanings.uzbekExample: Qo‘riqchisi yo‘q mulk himoyasiz qoldi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- وَلَدٌ هَدِمٌ : أَحْمَقُ.|2- جَعَلَ مِنْهُ وَلَداً هَدِماً : مُخَنَّثاً.
entries.uzbek: ahmoq bola; ayollarga xos deb qaralgan xatti-harakatli erkak haqidagi klassik tavsif

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: ahmoq, nodon
meanings.uzbekExample: U nodonona ish qilib qo‘ydi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: klassik qo‘llanishda erkak haqida: o‘sha davrda ayollarga xos deb qaralgan xatti-harakat yoki ko‘rinishni namoyon qiladigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu ma’no tarixiy shaxs tavsifi bo‘lib, zamonaviy tibbiy tashxis emas.

issues: مُخَنَّثاً zamonaviy tibbiy tashxis yoki haqorat sifatida berilmadi; tarixiy-kontekstual tavsif qilindi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- يَوْمٌ وَمِدٌ : شَدِيدُ الْحَرِّ مَعَ سُكُونِ الرِّيحِ- لَيْلَةٌ وَمِدَةٌ.|2- كَانَ وَمِداً عَلَيْهِ : أَيْ غَضْبَانَ.
entries.uzbek: dim va shamolsiz jazirama; biror kishidan g‘azablangan

meanings.arabicGloss: شَدِيدُ الْحَرِّ مَعَ سُكُونِ الرِّيحِ- لَيْلَةٌ وَمِدَةٌ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: kun yoki tun haqida: shamol esmaydigan, dim va juda issiq
meanings.uzbekExample: Dim va shamolsiz jazirama tunda uxlash qiyin bo‘ldi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: biror kishidan g‘azablangan, jahli chiqqan
meanings.uzbekExample: U do‘stidan qattiq g‘azablangan edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِل).|1- رَأَيْتُ مَنْظَراً بَشِعاً : قَبيحاً، دَمِيماً، كَريهاً.|2- بَشِعٌ في سُلوكِهِ : خَبيثٌ في سُلوكِهِ.
entries.uzbek: dahshatli va xunuk manzara; yaramas xulq

meanings.uzbekMeaning: manzara haqida: juda xunuk, jirkanch va dahshatli
meanings.uzbekExample: U dahshatli va yoqimsiz manzarani ko‘rdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: xatti-harakat haqida: yaramas, razil va buzuq
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning yaramas xatti-harakati qoralandi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيلٌ ).|-بَيْتٌ نَسِيقٌ : كَانَ مُنَظَّماً، مُنَسَّقاً- فِي جِيدِهَا عَقِيقٌ نَسِيقٌ.

meanings.arabicGloss: كَانَ مُنَظَّماً، مُنَسَّقاً- فِي جِيدِهَا عَقِيقٌ نَسِيقٌ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: qismlari tartib bilan, bir-biriga mos va uyg‘un joylashtirilgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Uy tartibli bezatilgan, marjonlar esa ipga uyg‘un tizilgan edi.

issues: Uy va ipga tizilgan aqiq misollari tartibli-uyg‘un joylashuvni bildiradi; manbada yo‘q «chiroyli, nafis» ma’nosi chiqarildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيلٌ).|-رَفَعَتْ صَوْتَهَا بِالعَوِيلِ : رَفْعُ الصَّوْتِ بِالْبُكَاءِ وَالصُّيَاحِ- بَدَأَ الصُّراخُ والعَويلُ عِنْدَما ظَهَرَتْ على صَفْحَةِ الْماءِ شاراتُ. (أحمد التوفيق).
entries.uzbek: fig‘on, baland ovozli yig‘i va qichqiriq

meanings.arabicGloss: رَفْعُ الصَّوْتِ بِالْبُكَاءِ وَالصُّيَاحِ- بَدَأَ الصُّراخُ والعَويلُ عِنْدَما ظَهَرَتْ على صَفْحَةِ الْماءِ شاراتُ. (أحمد التوفيق).
meanings.uzbekMeaning: qayg‘uda ovozni baland ko‘tarib yig‘lash va qichqirish; fig‘on
meanings.uzbekExample: Suv yuzida belgilar ko‘ringach, qichqiriq va fig‘on boshlandi.

issues: عَوِيلٌ bu yerda sifat emas, baland yig‘i va fig‘onni bildiruvchi ot

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيلٌ).|-فَحِيمُ الْوَجْهِ : شَدِيدُ السَّوَادِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yuz rangi haqida: juda to‘q qora
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu klassik sifat yuz rangining juda to‘q qora ekanini bildiradi.
meanings.register: klassik va ehtiyotkor qo‘llanadigan tashqi ko‘rinish tavsifi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيلٍ).|-رَجُلٌ لَعِيبٌ :كَثِيرُ اللَّعِبِ أَوِ الْمُزَاحِ وَالْمُدَاعَبَةِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: ko‘p o‘yin-kulgi, hazil va erkalash bilan mashg‘ul bo‘ladigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Hazilkash kishi davrada ko‘p o‘yin-kulgi qilardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيلٍ).|1- بَنَى دَارَهُ بالسَّمِيطِ : بِالأجُرِّ، أو القِرْمِيدِ القَائِمِ بَعْضُهُ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ.|2- نَعْلٌ سَمِيطٌ : لاَ رُقْعَةَ فِيهِ.
entries.uzbek: tik terilgan g‘isht yoki cherepitsa; yamoqsiz oyoq kiyim

meanings.arabicGloss: بِالأجُرِّ، أو القِرْمِيدِ القَائِمِ بَعْضُهُ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: qurilishda g‘isht yoki cherepitsani birining ustiga birini tik holda terish usuli
meanings.uzbekExample: Uy g‘ishtlarni birining ustiga birini tik terish usulida qurildi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: sandal yoki oyoq kiyim haqida: yamog‘i yo‘q, butun
meanings.uzbekExample: U yamog‘i yo‘q butun sandal kiydi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيلٍ).|1- كَلاَمٌ سَقِيمٌ : ضَعِيفٌ مُهَلْهَلٌ، سَخِيفٌ.|2- أُسْلُوبٌ سَقِيمٌ : تَافِهٌ، رَكِيكٌ.|3- رَجُلٌ سَقِيمٌ : بِهِ مَرَضٌ مُزْمِنٌ.
entries.uzbek: zaif va bema’ni gap; sayoz uslub; surunkali kasal

meanings.uzbekMeaning: gap haqida: mazmunan zaif, tuturuqsiz va bema’ni
meanings.uzbekExample: Tuturuqsiz gap tinglovchilarni ishontirmadi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: uslub haqida: sayoz, bo‘sh va ravon bo‘lmagan
meanings.uzbekExample: Matnning uslubi sayoz va g‘aliz edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: surunkali kasallikka chalingan
meanings.uzbekExample: Surunkali kasal bemor muntazam davolanardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-بَلَدٌ وَبِيءٌ :أَيْ بَلَدٌ كَثُرَ فِيهِ الوَبَاءُ- صَارَتْ شَوَارِعُ الْمَدِينَةِ وَبِيئَةً وَعَمَّ الفَسَادُ.

meanings.arabicGloss: أَيْ بَلَدٌ كَثُرَ فِيهِ الوَبَاءُ- صَارَتْ شَوَارِعُ الْمَدِينَةِ وَبِيئَةً وَعَمَّ الفَسَادُ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: yurt, shahar yoki ko‘cha haqida: epidemiya va yuqumli kasallik keng tarqalgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Epidemiya keng tarqalgan shaharda sanitariya choralari kuchaytirildi.

issues: Misoldagi فساد umumiy buzilish emas, epidemik-nosog‘lom holat kontekstida; soxta ikkinchi ma’no chiqarildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-حَقْلٌ شَجِيرٌ : كَثِيرُ الشَّجَرِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: dala yoki joy haqida: daraxtlari ko‘p, daraxtzor
meanings.uzbekExample: Daraxti ko‘p dala uzoqdan yashil ko‘rinardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-رَجُلٌ طَهِيرٌ :طَاهِرٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: nihoyatda pok va pokiza
meanings.uzbekExample: U pokiza inson sifatida tanilgan edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-هُوَ اللَّهُ القَدِيرُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ : مِنْ أَسْمَاءِ اللَّهِ الْحُسْنَى، صَاحِبُ القُدْرَةِ. الروم آية 54هُوَ العَلِيمُ القَدِيرُ ( قرآن).

meanings.arabicExample: هُوَ اللَّهُ القَدِيرُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
meanings.arabicGloss: مِنْ أَسْمَاءِ اللَّهِ الْحُسْنَى، صَاحِبُ القُدْرَةِ. الروم آية 54هُوَ العَلِيمُ القَدِيرُ ( قرآن).
meanings.uzbekMeaning: Al-Qadir — Allohning go‘zal ismlaridan biri; barcha narsaga qudrati yetuvchi, har narsaga qodir Zot
meanings.uzbekExample: U Biluvchi va Qodirdir. (Qur’on, Rum surasi, 30:54)

issues: Qudrat sifati va Al-Qadir go‘zal ismi manbada bitta diniy ma’no; sun’iy ravishda ikkiga ajratilmadi
Rum surasi 30:54 misoli o‘zbekcha mazmunda berildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- دَاءٌ وَبِيلٌ : دَاءٌ شَدِيدُ الوَطْأَةِ.|2- طَعَامٌ وَبِيلٌ : طَعَامٌ يُخَافُ سُوءُ عاَقِبَتِهِ.|3.المزمل آية 16فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ أَخْذاً وَبِيلاً ( قرآن) : أَخْذاً شَدِيداً .|4- مَرْعىً وَبِيلٌ : فَاسِدٌ، وَخِيمٌ.|5- وَبِيلُ الجَرَسِ : القَضِيبُ الَّذِي يُدَقُّ بِهِ الْجَرَسُ.
entries.uzbek: og‘ir kasallik; oqibati xavfli taom; qattiq jazo; yaroqsiz yaylov; qo‘ng‘iroq tili

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kasallik haqida: ta’siri va kechishi juda og‘ir
meanings.uzbekExample: Og‘ir kasallik bemorni holdan toydirdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: taom haqida: yeyilganda yomon oqibat keltirishidan qo‘rqiladigan, zararli
meanings.uzbekExample: Oqibati xavfli taom iste’mol qilinmadi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: tutish yoki jazolash haqida: juda qattiq va dahshatli
meanings.uzbekExample: Bas, Biz uni qattiq tutish bilan tutdik. (Qur’on, Muzzammil surasi, 73:16)

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yaylov haqida: buzilgan, nosog‘lom va chorva uchun zararli
meanings.uzbekExample: Chorva yaroqsiz va zararli yaylovdan qaytarildi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: qo‘ng‘iroq ichida urilib tovush chiqaradigan tayoqcha yoki til
meanings.uzbekExample: Qo‘ng‘iroq tili uning devoriga urilib tovush chiqardi.

issues: Muzzammil surasi 73:16 dagi وَبِيلاً qattiq tutish-jazolash ma’nosida saqlandi
Qo‘ng‘iroq ma’nosi uni urish harakati emas, ichida urilib tovush chiqaradigan tayoqcha yoki tildir

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|- بَيْتُهُ قَذِيفٌ : بَعِيدٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: uy yoki manzil haqida: uzoqda joylashgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning uyi bu yerdan ancha uzoqda edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-اِسْتَلْقَى فَوْقَ عُشْبٍ غَضِيرٍ : رَطْبٍ، نَاعِمٍ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: o‘t-o‘lan haqida: nam, barra va mayin
meanings.uzbekExample: U nam va mayin o‘t ustiga yotdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-إنَّهُ لَوَلَدٌ رَجِيمٌ : لَعِينٌ، مَلْعُونٌ- أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ.

meanings.arabicGloss: لَعِينٌ، مَلْعُونٌ- أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: la’natlangan va rahmatdan quvilgan; jumladan «la’natlangan shayton» iborasida
meanings.uzbekExample: La’natlangan shaytonning yomonligidan Allohdan panoh so‘rayman.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-أَذاقَهُ الْمُرَّ الأليمَ : الْمُرَّ الْمُؤْلِمَ والْمُوجِعَ. البقرة آية 10وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ ألِيمٌ (قرآن).

meanings.arabicGloss: الْمُرَّ الْمُؤْلِمَ والْمُوجِعَ. البقرة آية 10وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ ألِيمٌ (قرآن).
meanings.uzbekMeaning: jismoniy yoki ruhiy jihatdan qattiq og‘riq va azob beradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Ular uchun alamli azob bordir. (Qur’on, Baqara surasi, 2:10)

issues: Og‘riqli va azobli ma’no hamda achchiq-alamli misol bitta source sense doirasida saqlandi
Baqara surasi 2:10 misoli o‘zbekcha mazmunda berildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-أَرْضٌ عَشِيبَةٌ : كَثِيرَةُ العُشْبِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yer haqida: o‘t-o‘lani ko‘p va qalin
meanings.uzbekExample: O‘t-o‘lani qalin yer chorva uchun qulay edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-بَلَدٌ نَطِيطٌ : بَعِيدٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yurt yoki manzil haqida: juda uzoqda joylashgan
meanings.uzbekExample: U uzoqdagi yurtga safar qildi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-بَيْتٌ وَعِيبٌ : وَاسِعٌ- وِعَاءٌ وَعِيبٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: uy haqida: keng; idish haqida: sig‘imi katta
meanings.uzbekExample: Uy keng, idish esa ko‘p narsa sig‘diradigan edi.

issues: وِعَاءٌ وَعِيبٌ oddiy «idish» emas, sig‘imi katta idishning sifati

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-بِهِ حَنِينٌ إلَى الوَطَنِ :الاِشْتِياقُ إلَيْهِ، الشَّوْقُ- شعَرَ بِالحَنِينِ إلَى أيَّامِ الطُّفُولَةِ.

meanings.arabicGloss: الاِشْتِياقُ إلَيْهِ، الشَّوْقُ- شعَرَ بِالحَنِينِ إلَى أيَّامِ الطُّفُولَةِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: vatan, bolalik yoki o‘tgan davrni yana ko‘rishga bo‘lgan kuchli sog‘inch va qo‘msash
meanings.uzbekExample: U vatanini va bolalik kunlarini sog‘indi.

issues: حَنِينٌ bu yerda sifat emas, sog‘inch va qo‘msashni bildiruvchi ot; vatan va bolalik misollari bitta ma’noda

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-بِهِ غَمِيزٌ : عَيْبٌ. ¨ :مَا فِيهِ غَمِيزٌ أَوْ مَا فِيهِ غَمِيزَةٌ :-كَانَ شَاعِراً فَحْلاً لاَ غَمِيزَةَ فِيهِ وَلاَ وَهْنَ. (أبو سلام الجمحي).

meanings.arabicGloss: عَيْبٌ. ¨ :مَا فِيهِ غَمِيزٌ أَوْ مَا فِيهِ غَمِيزَةٌ :-كَانَ شَاعِراً فَحْلاً لاَ غَمِيزَةَ فِيهِ وَلاَ وَهْنَ. (أبو سلام الجمحي).
meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi yoki narsadagi nuqson, ayb yoki zaiflik; inkor shaklida «unda hech qanday nuqson yo‘q»
meanings.uzbekExample: U kuchli shoir edi, unda nuqson ham, zaiflik ham yo‘q edi.

issues: غَمِيزٌ «nuqson» degan ot; ما فيه غميز inkor gapida «unda nuqson yo‘q» bo‘ladi, «nuqsonsiz» alohida lug‘aviy ma’no emas

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-ثَوْبٌ صَبِيغٌ : مَصْبُوغٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: mato yoki kiyim haqida: bo‘yoq bilan rang berilgan, bo‘yalgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Bo‘yalgan mato quritishga yoyildi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-جَذِيمُ اليَدِ : مَقْطُوعُ اليَدِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: qo‘li kesilgan yoki tibbiy yo‘l bilan amputatsiya qilingan
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu sifat qo‘lidan ayrilgan kishiga nisbatan qo‘llanadi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-حَكِيمٌ وَزِينُ الرَّأْيِ :أَيْ رَاجِحُهُ، رَزِينُهُ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: fikr va mulohazasi puxta, vazmin hamda to‘g‘ri
meanings.uzbekExample: Donishmandning fikri puxta va vazmin edi.

issues: Sifat umumiy odam donoligidan ko‘ra uning fikri va mulohazasining puxtaligiga tegishli

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-دِيكُ وَدِيكٌ : سَمِينٌ- دَجَاجَةٌ وَدِيكَةٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: xo‘roz yoki tovuq haqida: semiz
meanings.uzbekExample: Semiz xo‘roz hovlida yurardi.

issues: Mavjud «tovuq yoki xo‘roz» tarjimasi ma’no bermasdi; semizlik sifati tiklandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-ذَلِيقُ اللِّسانِ : البَليغُ، الفَصيحُ.|2- لِسانٌ ذَليقٌ : حادٌّ.
entries.uzbek: ravon va fasohatli til; o‘tkir til

meanings.uzbekMeaning: til yoki nutq haqida: ravon, fasohatli va balog‘atli
meanings.uzbekExample: U ravon va fasohatli gapirdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: til haqida majozan: o‘tkir, keskin va achchiq
meanings.uzbekExample: U o‘tkir tili bilan suhbatdoshini ranjitdi.

issues: Manbada birinchi raqam tushib qolib bevosita 2- ga o‘tilgan; ravon-fasohatli va o‘tkir-keskin til ma’nolari alohida tiklandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-رَجُلٌ حَظِيظٌ : مَحْظُوظٌ، ذُو حَظٍّ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: omadi kelgan, baxti chopgan
meanings.uzbekExample: U omadli inson edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: o‘z ishini tartibga sola olmay, chalkash va sarosimada qolgan
meanings.uzbekExample: U ishlarini tartibga sololmay, sarosimada qoldi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-رَجُلٌ لَحِيمٌ : بَدَنُهُ كَثِيرُ اللَّحْمِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: tana tuzilishi haqida: gavdasi to‘la, eti ko‘p
meanings.uzbekExample: U gavdasi to‘la kishi edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-رَجُلٌ لَعِينٌ : مَلْعُونٌ.|2- إِنَّهُ اللَّعِينُ بِذَاتِهِ : الشَّيْطَانُ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: la’natlangan, rahmatdan quvilgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Manbada bu sifat la’natlangan kishiga nisbatan qo‘llangan.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: al-La’in — «la’natlangan zot» ma’nosida shaytonning sifatlaridan biri
meanings.uzbekExample: Diniy matnlarda shayton «la’natlangan» deb sifatlanadi.

issues: Manbada birinchi raqam tushib qolgan; la’natlangan kishi va shaytonning al-La’in sifati alohida saqlandi
